title: Consistent Incompatible module status copy
summary: Super Admin overview plugin warnings now use Incompatible and Code not shipped — the same labels as the modules registry — instead of calling those cells Blocked.
changes: Label Super Admin module alerts for incompatible and code-not-shipped plugins with the same terms as the modules registry chips.
Keep Disabled and Active records as separate alert kinds with their existing meanings.
version_rationale: Patch release: aligns staff-facing status copy without changing the module incompatibility matrix or lifecycle behaviour.
validation: PHPUnit AdminAnalyticsDashboardTest asserts Super Admin alerts use Incompatible (not Blocked) and match modules registry copy.
PHPUnit ModuleAdministrationAndNavigationTest still shows Incompatible on the modules registry.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: None for this copy alignment; underlying module availability rules are unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore Blocked labels on Super Admin incompatible plugin alerts.
provenance: Blocked vs Incompatible copy alignment for issue #139, pull request #239.
